description: Fund a prepaid Rozo x402 balance with USDC or USDT, through a one-time deposit address you pay from your own wallet. Same fields as POST /v1/x402/topup: amount (USD), token, chain. Topup coins: USDC/USDT on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Solana, Arbitrum; USDC on Base, Stellar. Native coins (ETH, BNB, SOL, ...) and BTC/Lightning are not accepted for top ups. Holding a native coin or sats? Use create_deposit_order / ROZO Checkout to top up OpenRouter instead. The x402 payment leg is USDC on Base (eip155:8453) only, scheme "exact"; Solana payment leg is coming later. USDT can fund the balance (x402_topup) but never pays a seller directly. Without an agent key, one is created and returned ONCE in this result: store it, it owns the balance. Minimum $5.

agentKey.description: Agent key (ak_...). Prefer setting it once as "Authorization: Bearer ak_..." on the MCP connection; this argument overrides that. Never share it.

amount.description: USD amount to credit, e.g. "20". Minimum 5.

chain.description: Chain id: "1" Ethereum, "56" BNB Chain, "137" Polygon, "900" Solana, "42161" Arbitrum, "8453" Base, "1500" Stellar.

token.description: Coin you will send: USDC or USDT (USDT not on Base or Stellar).

name: x402_topup
title: Top up the x402 balance
